selection: Before reading heldout scores: lowest pooled development leg-position RMSE in each family (friction vs contact time); ties lexical. Evaluate these representatives plus baseline closed-loop even if not improved; diagnostic selection is not acceptance.

walking.score: last10s body forward RMSE, world/body yaw tracking error, Euler heading slope; full-run termination/tilt

acceptance: No automatic promotion. Show all speed/yaw tradeoffs; a short-branch score cannot establish better walking.
scope: Deterministic fixed flat initial state. Split contains only three same-run support snapshots per subset, not independent seeds or broad generalization.
